entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — Walk 20 minutes at a comfortable pace:

Good morning. Today's plan gives you a straightforward 20-minute walk at a comfortable pace, which is a great way to connect with your body without pushing too hard. Just focus on the movement and the rhythm of your steps. You've got this — show up and enjoy the simple win of getting moving.
